arguments.text: Let the pack go. Settle to your own steady pace.

text: let_go: shaft power 194 W vs 164 W sustainable with no wash benefit (push_local equals push_along); pod reserve would empty in about 1.4 km.

arguments.condition: w_bal_pod_frac < 0.4 and remaining_m > 1200 and shaft_power_w > sustainable_shaft_power_w + 4
arguments.message: pod reserve under 40 pct with shaft power above sustainable: if still on the wash (push_local well above push_along) cue let_go now; if off the wash, ease to sustainable shaft power
the wash benefit has gone (push_local back to push_along): paddler is off the pack; settle to sustainable shaft power, do not chase
the pod reserve reads empty but speed at this rate holds: shaft critical power is probably set low, check cp_implied_w
pod reserve left near the finish: consider the finish cue sized to the reserve

text: no cue: on the wash (push_local 0.35 vs push_along 0.23) at 172 W shaft, pod reserve 84 pct; worth hanging on for now. Replaced boat-model watches with pod-based ones to time a let_go.

arguments.text: Let them go. Settle into your own steady rhythm.

text: let_go: wash benefit faded to zero over the last minute at 170 W; staying on would need well above the 163 W sustainable shaft power, so settle to own pace.

arguments.text: Ease a touch, settle at 2:29 pace.

text: ease: off the wash at 170 W shaft vs 163 W sustainable for three minutes; pod reserve would empty in 3.6 km of the 9 km left.

arguments.text: Ease off now, steady effort, 2:58 pace into this current.

text: ease: shaft 184 W vs 161 W sustainable, pod reserve 37 pct and falling 8 pct a minute, would empty in 800 m with 8.3 km left; target set for the adverse push.

arguments.text: A touch easier, then hold 2:56 steady.

text: ease: shaft settled near 164 W, above the 160.6 W sustainable; with pod reserve at 29 pct it would empty with about 4.5 km still to go.

arguments.text: Lift a little, settle at 2:34 with this tailwind.

text: push: shaft 156 W is below both critical power (159 W) and the 161 W sustainable, speed per watt shows no fatigue, so a small lift to about 160 W.

arguments.text: Back off a touch, hold 2:35 steady to the turn.

text: ease: shaft crept up to 165 W against 161 W sustainable; pod reserve 25 pct would empty with 4.8 km left. Target about 158 W keeps a sprint reserve.
no cue: shaft 163 W and falling toward the 161 W sustainable after the turn, push still favourable, pod reserve 25 pct; nothing new to say.

arguments.text: Ease right off now, 3:06 pace on this leg.

text: ease: shaft jumped to 183 W into the adverse push, pod reserve 7.5 pct would empty in 170 m with 6.6 km left and speed is fading; target about 157 W.

arguments.text: Ease slightly, 3:09 pace, let your breathing settle.

text: ease: pod reserve is empty (0.6 pct) at 161 W, just above the 159 W critical power, with a 9 pct fade and 6 km left; drop just below critical power to avoid a blow-up.

arguments.message: speed at this rate has fallen more than 11 pct against early race (a 5 to 9 pct fade is already explained by the lower power and the adverse legs): possible blow-up or rate too high
about 450 m to go: decide the finishing sprint from the pod reserve left (it was near empty at 5.7 km to go, held at critical power)

text: no cue: holding 160 W at critical power with the pod reserve near empty and speed recovering on the favourable leg; removed stale watches and added a finish-approach watch.

arguments.text: Ease a touch, hold steady effort by feel, not pace.

text: ease: pod reserve empty and shaft crept to 164 W above the 159 W critical power with 5.2 km left; no pace target because a turn is about 230 m away and the push will reverse.
no cue: just through the turn at 153 W, a little under critical power, so the near-empty pod reserve rebuilds slightly for the finish; speed holding.

arguments.text: Into the current, ease to steady effort; let pace drop.

text: ease: pod reserve empty and shaft up to 165 W into the adverse push, above the 159 W critical power, with 4.5 km left and a 7 pct fade.

arguments.text: Lengthen out, drop the rate two, same effort.

text: rate_down: a 7 pct fade at 60 spm has lasted 15 minutes while effort sits near critical power; a tiring paddler goes faster at a lower rate.

arguments.reason: held 160-163 W shaft for about 15 minutes with the pod reserve reading empty and no blow-up; speed and fade stable, not worsening, so the 158.7 W test value is a little low

text: no cue: rate now 58 with speed slightly up at 163 W; raised shaft critical power to 161.5 W because 15 minutes at 160-163 W on an empty pod reserve brought no blow-up.
no cue: steady at 162 W against 161.6 W sustainable, speed holding, 3 km left; pacing is even.

arguments.text: Steady into this current, save it for the finish.

text: ease: shaft 166 W into the adverse push, above the 161.5 W critical power with the pod reserve empty and 2.4 km left; keep something for the sprint.
no cue: at 161 W, right at critical power with 2 km left; effort is where it should be until the sprint.

arguments.text: Settle a touch, steady to 400 to go, then empty it.

text: ease: lifting to 167 W with 1.7 km left and the pod reserve empty; an early surge risks a slowdown before the line, so hold near 161 W until the sprint.
no cue: shaft power has collapsed to 124 W (a blow-up after running on an empty reserve); pushing now would prolong it, let the reserve rebuild and decide the sprint near 400 m to go.

arguments.text: Build now, 2:37 pace, sprint from 400 to go.

text: push: final 1 km leg with a steady favourable push, shaft 152 W recovering, pod reserve back to 20 pct and sustainable 172 W, so build to about 165 W and sprint late.

arguments.text: Lift now, 2:59 pace, all out at 200 to go.

arguments.message: about 220 m to go: cue finish now to spend what is left of the pod reserve

text: push: 440 m left with 20 pct pod reserve, enough for about 185 W to the line; lift now and sprint all out from about 220 m (watch set).

arguments.text: Go now, everything to the line!

text: finish: 226 m left with 16 pct pod reserve, enough for about 200 W to the line; spend it all now.
no cue: 16 m to the line, inside the last 100 m where cues are not allowed.
